name: Arnav Garg
about: I turn messy, ambiguous data into decisions leadership can act on — whether that means tuning a fraud model, forecasting demand, or figuring out why a metric moved. Three years across compliance, travel tech, and AI recruiting have had me working the same core problem under different titles: SQL, Python, and enough business context to know which number actually matters.
Currently a Senior Business Analyst at a regulatory compliance consultancy in the NYC area, with an M.S. in Business Analytics from UCLA Anderson.

highlights.title: Reducing false positives in AML transaction monitoring
bullets: Cut false-positive alert volume by 20% across transaction monitoring and risk-rating scenarios through model tuning and threshold analysis — without losing regulatory coverage.
Led data validation for a legacy-to-cloud AML platform migration, reconciling 1M+ alerts, transactions, and sanctions-screening outputs.
Built SQL/Python reconciliation tooling that cut manual validation effort by 90% and sped up compliance sign-off.

highlights.title: Scoring candidates and flagging interview fraud with LLMs
bullets: Designed and refined LLM prompts for AI-generated interview questions, cutting screening time and lifting hiring efficiency by 50%.
Built a candidate scoring framework translating interview responses into structured, recruiter-facing evaluations — shortening time-to-shortlist by 70%.
Defined integrity signals (response timing, consistency, engagement) to flag suspicious sessions for review instead of auto-disqualifying, reducing false-positive fraud flags.

highlights.title: Forecasting demand and automating pricing decisions
bullets: Built forecasting and predictive models that drove ~10% revenue growth for major airline clients through data-driven pricing and inventory decisions.
Translated client pricing strategy into automated Python/SQL workflows, shifting teams from intuition-driven to data-driven rate-setting.
Automated end-to-end data ingestion and KPI dashboards, improving pipeline efficiency 5x.
